_comment: Per-tool recency descriptions for the serena MCP. Keys are BARE tool names; the harness CLI prefixes them with `serena_` (opencode's <server>_<tool> form) when it merges this into HARNESS_MCP_TOOL_RECENCY for the proxy. Keep each line minimal — the recency block is budget-constrained and serena ships many tools. See architecture/mcp.md 'Tool recency descriptions'.

tools.get_symbols_overview: Top-level symbols of a file — orient here before reading the whole file.
tools.find_symbol: Locate a symbol by `name_path` (e.g. `Class/method`); set `include_body` to get its code, else you get location only.
tools.find_referencing_symbols: Find a symbol's callers/uses; run before renaming or deleting it.
tools.search_for_pattern: Project-wide regex search; for symbol lookups prefer find_symbol.
tools.find_file: Find files by name/glob; for file contents use search_for_pattern.
tools.list_dir: List a directory; `recursive` walks subtrees, default one level.
tools.read_file: Read a file by relative path; to read one symbol prefer find_symbol with `include_body`.
tools.replace_symbol_body: Replace a symbol's full body; exclude the signature line, don't re-include it.
tools.insert_after_symbol: Insert code right after a symbol's definition (e.g. a new method).
tools.insert_before_symbol: Insert code right before a symbol's definition (e.g. imports above a class).
tools.replace_content: In-file find/replace (regex optional); for a whole symbol use replace_symbol_body.
tools.create_text_file: Create/overwrite a file — overwrites silently, so confirm it's new.
tools.execute_shell_command: Run a shell command in the project (build/test/git); mutating commands change real files.
tools.write_memory: Save a project note for later sessions; one topic each, sparingly.
tools.read_memory: Read a memory by name; call list_memories first if unsure.
tools.list_memories: List saved memory names; cheap, call before read/write to avoid guessing.
